Loss report: gitlab -> argo
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (spec) is not written to the Argo file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.env: copied into the env of every container (a step variable of the same name wins)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.inputs: string parameter (input dry_run has type boolean, which Argo parameters lack; it is a string parameter and the type stays in the marker)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy/step/script step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.filter.branches
